name: Texas Gas Henderson County Expansion Project

values.EndLocation: AB Brown Generating Station, Posey County

researcher_notes: No existing row: P0263 is the Texas Gas main line, P2518 the cancelled Clarksville line and P7794 the Borealis project. This is a new 24 mile, 20 inch lateral from a new tie-in in Henderson County, Kentucky to a new meter station at the CenterPoint AB Brown plant in Posey County, Indiana, with 220 MMcf/d of capacity for CenterPoint. It also adds one 4,863 horsepower compressor unit at Slaughters station in Webster County, Kentucky. Length is 24 mi (about 38.6 km), above the 25 km threshold. The EIA October 2025 release (sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 1109) lists it as Complete with an in-service date of May 2024, 24 mi, 220 MMcf/d, 20 in, FERC docket CP21-467. The Federal Register notice of intent from October 2021 and a local news story from July 2021 state the length, size, capacity and sponsor. EIA is one origin; the Federal Register notice is independent of it. Not confirmed by a separate in-service notice from the operator or FERC. Owner copied from the existing Texas Gas rows (Boardwalk Pipeline Partners, Loews Corp). The ownership share and the ownership refs should be checked by a person. Cost not found. Route not researched: no route fields staged, route would need FERC GIS or the FEIS maps. ProposalYear 2021 is from the July 2021 news story and August 2021 scoping notice. The FERC FEIS news page loads only through a bot wall, so it is not cited.
